record.original_question: For a modular numerical semigroup S(a, b, 1), find formulas for the Frobenius number F(S(a, b, 1)), multiplicity m(S(a, b, 1)), type t(S(a, b, 1)), and embedding dimension e(S(a, b, 1)) in terms of the parameters a and b.

evidence.quote: A formula for g(S(a, b, 1)) in function of a and b is given in [53]. The problems of finding formulas for F(S(a, b, 1)), m(S(a, b, 1)), t(S(a, b, 1)) and e(S(a, b, 1)) remain open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A proportionally modular Diophantine inequality is an expression of the form $a x \bmod b \le c x$, where $a, b, c$ are positive integers. The set
$$S(a,b,c) \;=\; \{\, x \in \mathbb{N} : a x \bmod b \le c x \,\}$$
is a numerical semigroup (a cofinite submonoid of $(\mathbb{N},+)$ containing $0$).

For a numerical semigroup $S \subseteq \mathbb{N}$, define:
- the Frobenius number $F(S) = \max(\mathbb{Z}\setminus S)$;
- the multiplicity $m(S) = \min(S\setminus\{0\})$;
- the embedding dimension $e(S)$, the cardinality of the (unique) minimal system of generators of $S$;
- the type $t(S) = \#\{\, z \in \mathbb{Z}\setminus S : z + s \in S \text{ for all } s \in S\setminus\{0\}\,\}$ (the number of pseudo-Frobenius numbers).

Specialize to the case $c = 1$, i.e.\ to the modular numerical semigroup
$$S(a,b,1) \;=\; \{\, x \in \mathbb{N} : a x \bmod b \le x \,\}, \qquad a,b \in \mathbb{Z}_{>0}.$$

Provide explicit closed-form expressions, in terms of the parameters $a$ and $b$ alone, for each of the four invariants
$$F\bigl(S(a,b,1)\bigr), \qquad m\bigl(S(a,b,1)\bigr), \qquad t\bigl(S(a,b,1)\bigr), \qquad e\bigl(S(a,b,1)\bigr).$$
artifact.status_search_result: A search indicates that while an algorithm of Euclidean-type complexity exists to compute the Frobenius number of S(a,b,1), and a formula for the genus g(S(a,b,1)) is known, no explicit closed-form formulas for F, m, t, and e of S(a,b,1) in terms of a and b appear in the literature; the problem is listed as open in the standard problem list on numerical semigroups.

status_evidence.title: On the Frobenius number of a modular Diophantine inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Algorithm with Euclidean-type complexity for the Frobenius number of S(a,b,1); no closed form given.
status_evidence.claim: Frobenius number of S(a,b,1) is computed algorithmically rather than by closed formula.

status_evidence.title: Numerical semigroups problem list
status_evidence.snippet: The problems of finding formulas for F(S(a,b,1)), m(S(a,b,1)), t(S(a,b,1)) and e(S(a,b,1)) remain open.
status_evidence.claim: These four invariants of S(a,b,1) are listed as open problems.
